what: Rows published to the shared store by the CI run of POC-6 over 3,000 identifier-bearing rows (ai4privacy/pii-masking-200k). Each one is a defect: the published policy says these must stay private. Text is as quoted in that run report, truncated there at 160 characters, so a truncated row cannot exercise a pattern that would have matched only after the cut.
